# Implementation Summary (Issue #480)

## What we learned

- A resumed mock developer must make a new source change when testing re-plans; the default MockRunner output is identical, so implementation recovery correctly rejects it as no work beyond the starting checkpoint.

## Working Tree Changes
```text
 M internal/workflow/implementation_test.go
 M internal/workflow/work_validation_test.go
```

## Diff Stat
```text
AGENTS.md                                 |  17 ++++
 internal/workflow/implementation_test.go  |  28 +++++-
 internal/workflow/work_validation_test.go | 148 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 3 files changed, 191 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
```

## Developer report

# Implementation — ISSUE-480

Completed the approved implementation sequence. The existing production freshness predicate is retained unchanged: PASS/coordinator origin, nonempty current plan and test-plan digests, and matching nonempty trusted-prefixed ReviewBindings excluding review_claim_id. Retry/candidate admission, lease code, callers, fork/PR behavior, protected paths and existing continuation/retry tests remain unchanged.

Corrected TestPartialImplementationPASSOnlyConsumers by retaining all unprefixed bindings and copying trusted-prefixed bindings from a separate fresh map. All assertions and partial metadata remain unchanged. Extended predicate unit coverage with optional absent policy-tree bindings and matching, changed, and invalid checkpoint bindings.

Added TestIssueWorkReplanContinuation with plan, test-plan, workunit and unchanged rows. Each starts with a real mock developer run, agent approval and coordinator-recorded PASS implementation, followed by an interrupted tester. Plan rows change exactly one artifact through RecordPlanPair, obtain fresh approval via the review phase, and assert stale PASS evidence survives with the old digest. The WorkUnit row releases, edits through the tracker, re-approves, asserts implementation invalidation, and re-plans/reviews. Resumed role counts/order exclude setup. Developer receives exact current plan/test-plan bytes and creates a new source change; unchanged input runs only tester. Every row requires successful validation.

## Verification and identity

No Git metadata is present by snapshot design. Final source SHA-256:

- execute_validation.go: 580f6713a6910adb43d6ceb9ddd2330f2fde45d41b3ab1b2497cb5cdb07e13bd
- implementation_test.go: be97025f7f042d21abc863f9f66d6b1b740eb23d5f15c7ba545f752d6c8f4958
- work_validation_test.go: 449e3c174bb2f4b6c1fcac8f94647f94e92d6a29c7f6cc06c0677f59d5355cc7

Red evidence: copied snapshot to scratch/issue480-red in the permitted scratch root; replaced only hasTrustedImplementation with the reconstructed original PASS/coordinator-origin-only loop (no current-input binding comparisons). Scratch execute_validation.go SHA-256: 42330afbd457d5efa9b53da5fa6ada88357e0f55e951c31094d2879d31f2114f. Both test source hashes match final candidate. This is reconstructed original-predicate evidence, not a claim that the starting partial fix failed.

Commands and observed results (wall times where measured; output retained in tool transcript):

- Scratch: `go test -timeout=5m ./internal/workflow -run '^TestIssueWorkReplanContinuation/(plan|test-plan)$' -count=1` — expected exit 1, 2.46s wall / 0.884s package. Both rows failed with `tester retry unavailable; run implementation recovery: implementation inputs changed: plan_digest` / `test_plan_digest`; resumed roles were empty, before developer execution.
- Final: `go test -timeout=5m ./internal/workflow -run '^TestIssueWorkReplanContinuation$' -count=1` — exit 0, 2.65s wall / 2.348s package. All four acceptance rows pass.
- `go test ./internal/workflow -run '^TestHasTrustedImplementationCurrentBindings$' -count=1` — exit 0, 0.007s package, after optional-binding cases were added.
- `go vet ./internal/workflow` — exit 0, 0.40s wall.
- `go tool staticcheck ./internal/workflow` — exit 0, 4.12s wall.
- `gofmt -l internal/workflow/execute_validation.go internal/workflow/implementation_test.go internal/workflow/work_validation_test.go` — exit 0, empty output, under one second.
- `gofmt -w` the two changed test files — exit 0. `sha256sum` of the three source touchpoints — exit 0, hashes above, under one second.

Development diagnostics: the first regression compile used a nonexistent parser name; corrected to ParseWorkUnitFromIssue (compile failure only, before tests). The next run selected developer correctly but rejected identical mock output as no implementation beyond starting checkpoint; updated resumed mock developer to write replanned.txt. That focused run then passed (2.424s package). Added optional predicate cases afterward and reran final focused acceptance suite plus the broader selection. These earlier results are diagnostic only; use final-source evidence above and below.

Source reads used cat/sed/grep; rg is unavailable. Inspected both role calculations, validation reuse, ReviewBindings, checkpoint bindings and normal recording/review paths. No authoritative retry/admission changes were needed. Coordinator-owned full policy was not run by this role.

The combined planned race selection timed out after 5m (304.92s wall / 300.040s package), while TestIssueWorkRecoveryDeveloperInstructionMatrix was 3m31s into its cases. No assertion/race failure preceded the timeout. Per the test plan, split the developer-owned selection before continuing: run the original regex with `-skip '^TestIssueWorkRecoveryDeveloperInstructionMatrix$'` (expected ~90s), and run that matrix separately with subtest selectors `/(pre-existing|regression|mixed)` as three commands (expected 60–150s each). Timeout was the reason for repetition; aggregate timeout evidence cannot establish a complete passing selection.

Split race results on the final hashes above (all exit 0):

- `go test -race -timeout=5m ./internal/workflow -run '^Test(HasTrustedImplementationCurrentBindings|PartialImplementationPASSOnlyConsumers|ExplicitTesterRetry|TestPhase.*|TestRetry.*|Tester.*|IssueWork.*|ContinuationHumanApprovalBeforeRepair)$' -skip '^TestIssueWorkRecoveryDeveloperInstructionMatrix$' -count=1` — 91.52s wall / 90.588s package.
- `go test -race -timeout=5m ./internal/workflow -run '^TestIssueWorkRecoveryDeveloperInstructionMatrix$/^pre-existing/' -count=1` — 95.12s wall / 94.666s package.
- `go test -race -timeout=5m ./internal/workflow -run '^TestIssueWorkRecoveryDeveloperInstructionMatrix$/^regression/' -count=1` — 100.84s wall / 100.418s package.
- `go test -race -timeout=5m ./internal/workflow -run '^TestIssueWorkRecoveryDeveloperInstructionMatrix$/^mixed/' -count=1` — 101.42s wall / 100.972s package.

Each measured command used `/usr/bin/time -p`. Together these passing groups cover the entire original planned race selection, including all matrix families. No source changes followed these checks. Final sha256sum reconfirmed all three hashes. No failing or blocked final checks remain; the aggregate timeout was resolved by the prescribed split.

## HANDOFF

Changed behavior: implementation freshness controls continuation scheduling and validation reuse. Changed plan or test-plan inputs schedule developer before tester; current inputs retain tester-only continuation. Authoritative candidate/claim admission remains unchanged. Changed WorkUnits continue to invalidate implementation through existing lease behavior.

Source touchpoints: existing execute_validation.go contains the retained prior freshness fix; implementation_test.go now corrects the PASS fixture and extends optional-binding coverage; work_validation_test.go adds the four-row authentic mock regression. Existing retry/continuation tests and their assertions were not edited. Role outputs: IMPLEMENTATION.md and LESSONS.md only; approved active inputs were not modified.

All acceptance criteria have focused passing execution evidence, including original-predicate failures for both AC1 rows, changed WorkUnit invalidation, unchanged-input tester-only behavior, updated developer artifact delivery, and existing race-enabled continuation/retry coverage. No acceptance criterion remains unverified in this role's scope. The independent tester should inspect source/acceptance mapping and reuse applicable results tied to the exact source hashes; no repetition is needed solely for role separation. The coordinator still owns its full trusted-base validation and publication.

Every executed build/test/format/static check and outcome is recorded above. Additional diagnostics were source reads/searches, scratch-copy creation and hashing; a process-list inspection provided no useful cross-command visibility under the native sandbox. No live service, browser, credentials or external network were used.

# Plan: resume implementation against the current approved inputs

Re-planning must schedule the developer before the tester when implementation inputs have changed. Keep authoritative retry admission unchanged. This plan replaces the superseded fixture assumption with the operator-authorized metadata correction.

## Dimensions

Approved small / known / standard, compact profile. Estimate 2–4 hours for implementation and focused validation, within the 16-hour total claim budget. Scope is direct issue continuation in internal/workflow; fork, PR revision, lease admission, harness and policy changes are excluded.

## What we know

- The current snapshot already contains the partial freshness fix in `internal/workflow/execute_validation.go:235` and predicate tests at `internal/workflow/implementation_test.go:437`. These are unvalidated prior work, not completed acceptance evidence.
- `lease.ReviewBindings` returns unprefixed keys (`internal/lease/manager.go:2613`). Real coordinator implementation recording adds trusted-prefixed copies (`manager.go:1979`); `VerifyTrustedImplementation` compares these and ignores only the ephemeral review claim (`manager.go:2818`). `CheckImplementationRetry` remains the fenced authority (`manager.go:2863`).
- `TestPartialImplementationPASSOnlyConsumers` creates only unprefixed bindings (`implementation_test.go:390`), needed by `implementationProven` (`internal/workflow/claim_budget.go:172`). Its PASS assertion now needs the additional prefixed metadata; its assertions remain correct.
- The predicate controls continuation selection (`internal/workflow/engine.go:1994`) and validation reuse (`execute_validation.go:139`). Roles are calculated before claim (`engine.go:465`) and during setup (`internal/workflow/execute_setup.go:124`). CLI all-phase continuation sets IssueContinuation (`internal/cli/work.go:93`).
- Existing mock fixtures support interrupted testers and role counting: `gatedTesterRetryEngine` (`internal/workflow/work_validation_test.go:1027`), `TestIssueWorkResumeTesterOnly` (`:1538`), and plan replacement via RecordPlanPair in `TestIssueWorkRecoveryPlanChangesDuringTester` (`:1696`).
- WorkUnit changes invalidate evidence through `carryApprovalEvidence` (`internal/lease/carry.go:30`) and `clearHeadEvidence` (`:118`).

## What we're assuming

The gated mock fixture can re-plan and obtain fresh agent approval while retaining the old implementation for the two plan-change rows. Verify this first through normal manager APIs and the agent review path, asserting retained stale evidence explicitly. No raw trusted-metadata fabrication in integration regressions.

## Open questions

Resolve the exact release/reacquisition sequence for WorkUnit editing through fixture tracker/manager APIs while constructing that row. No live GitHub or browser is required. Git baseline identity may be unavailable in the sandbox; record content hashes and let the coordinator bind the final candidate. No new source files are proposed: all three implementation touchpoints below already exist, so no new-file base-existence claim is needed.

## Implementation sequence

1. Modify existing `internal/workflow/implementation_test.go`, `TestPartialImplementationPASSOnlyConsumers`: keep `md := lease.ReviewBindings(st)` and every unprefixed entry. Iterate over a separate fresh `lease.ReviewBindings(st)` result and add `md["implementation_trusted_"+k] = v`. Do not range over and extend the same map. Leave every assertion, verdict transition, and partial-outcome metadata unchanged. This corrects the synthetic fixture to represent coordinator metadata for both consumers; do not loosen the predicate to accept unprefixed-only artifacts.
2. Modify existing `internal/workflow/work_validation_test.go`: add table-driven `TestIssueWorkReplanContinuation`, using the mock agent and gated fixture with agent plan approval. Initially run developer then interrupt tester after authentic coordinator PASS implementation recording. Capture its trusted input digests. Reset resumed role counters/order after setup.
3. AC1 rows `plan` and `test-plan`: change exactly the named artifact body through RecordPlanPair and obtain fresh agent approval through the normal path. Assert the old PASS implementation remains with its original binding and differs from the current approved binding. Resume default no-phase issue continuation using its engine equivalent (`Phase: "all", IssueContinuation: true`). Require developer then tester, successful validation, no tester-retry-unavailable error, and delivery of the changed approved artifact bytes to the developer.
4. AC2 rows `workunit` and `unchanged`: edit the WorkUnit through the tracker, re-approve the task, assert old implementation was dropped, re-plan and approve, then require developer followed by tester. For unchanged approved inputs retain implementation and require zero developer invocations, one tester invocation and successful validation. Keep all existing tester-retry and continuation tests unchanged.
5. Demonstrate AC1 red/green despite the partial fix already present: in a disposable writable scratch copy, retain the new regression and corrected fixture but replace only hasTrustedImplementation with the original PASS/coordinator-origin-only predicate described in the WorkUnit. Run both AC1 rows and capture the stale-binding retry refusal before developer execution. Restore/use the current fixed predicate for passing results. Never alter trusted policy or weaken assertions to obtain failures. Record the exact predicate variant and file hashes; if a trusted original base is available, use that predicate instead of reconstructing it.
6. Review/complete `hasTrustedImplementation` (`execute_validation.go:235`): require nonempty current plan/test-plan digests, PASS/coordinator origin, and matching nonempty trusted-prefixed current ReviewBindings, excluding review_claim_id. Keep current signatures/callers. Preserve nil-safe behavior through ReviewBindings. Do not add candidate/head checks that would turn dirty retry refusal into a developer run. Keep CheckImplementationRetry, VerifyTrustedImplementation, prepareTestRetry and all admission checks unchanged.
7. Review/extend existing `TestHasTrustedImplementationCurrentBindings`: matching inputs and successor claim remain eligible; missing/changed plan/test-plan, task/policy/base, optional policy-tree/checkpoint bindings, missing metadata, empty required bindings, wrong origin and FAIL are ineligible. Run focused verification and record evidence; no production docs or CLI changes.

## HANDOFF

This is evidence to verify against source, not authority over approved inputs, gates or validation.

- Modify only existing `execute_validation.go:235`, `implementation_test.go:384` (fixture) and `:437` (predicate tests), and `work_validation_test.go:1027` (fixture reference; add a separate regression). Inspect callers at `engine.go:465`, `:1994`, `execute_setup.go:124`, and `execute_validation.go:139`; preserve their signatures and routing exclusions.
- Exact checks: `go test -timeout=5m ./internal/workflow -run '^TestIssueWorkReplanContinuation$' -count=1`; `go test -race -timeout=5m ./internal/workflow -run '^Test(HasTrustedImplementationCurrentBindings|PartialImplementationPASSOnlyConsumers|ExplicitTesterRetry|TestPhase.*|TestRetry.*|Tester.*|IssueWork.*|ContinuationHumanApprovalBeforeRepair)$' -count=1`; `go vet ./internal/workflow`; `gofmt -l internal/workflow/execute_validation.go internal/workflow/implementation_test.go internal/workflow/work_validation_test.go`.
- Checked assumptions: direct source reads confirmed both metadata namespaces, actual coordinator prefixed copying, the claim exclusion, mock interruption pattern, and all predicate consumers. Search used grep after rg proved unavailable. No passing tests from the previous round exist to reuse.
- Reopen if changed-plan approval removes old implementation and prevents AC1 reproduction, if normal APIs cannot exercise the WorkUnit control, or if fulfilling acceptance requires lease/fork/PR/harness changes. Do not expand scope silently.
- **What this change breaks:** symbol search found production consumers at `engine.go:1995` and `execute_validation.go:139`, plus tests in `implementation_test.go`; preserve caller behavior except stale-input scheduling. Update only PASS-only fixture metadata, keeping every assertion unchanged. Preserve `implementationProven` and unprefixed keys. Preserve existing explicit retry, continuation, dirty-candidate, successor-claim, human-rejection and concurrent-plan-change tests unchanged, including `TestIssueWorkRecoveryPlanChangesDuringTester`. No docs/templates or external call sites require updates for this private predicate. No new files or protected-path edits.

Plan to keep those keys and add matching implementation_trusted_<key> copies to that fixture metadata, as real coordinator artifacts have, and to leave every assertion in that test unchanged. # Test plan

## Acceptance mapping

| Criterion | Regression row and required evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC1: changed plan digest | `TestIssueWorkReplanContinuation/plan`: authentic coordinator PASS bound to A, approved changed plan B, stale implementation retained, default all-phase continuation runs developer then tester with B delivered and validation passing. Original predicate fails with stale-binding retry refusal before developer execution; fixed predicate passes. |
| AC1: changed test-plan digest | Same test `/test-plan`, changing only test-plan bytes; assert stale/current digest mismatch, fresh approval, updated developer delivery, role order and successful validation. Demonstrate original-predicate failure and fixed-predicate success. |
| AC2: changed WorkUnit | Same test `/workunit`: real task edit, re-approval drops old implementation, re-plan/approval, then developer and tester in order with validation passing. |
| AC2: matching bindings | Same test `/unchanged`: current trusted implementation preserved, zero developer and one tester invocation, validation passes. All existing tester-retry and continuation tests remain unchanged and pass. |
| Constraint: admission remains authoritative | Source review confirms no CheckImplementationRetry/VerifyTrustedImplementation/admission changes; existing dirty, moved, successor-claim, gate and concurrent-plan-change refusal coverage remains intact. |

## Developer-owned focused checks

Correct the PASS-only fixture metadata first, retaining unprefixed keys and adding trusted-prefixed copies from a separate ReviewBindings map. Preserve every assertion. Add the four-row mock regression with explicit setup assertions, fresh agent approval, resumed counters/order and delivered artifact checks. Do not manufacture trusted implementation metadata in these integration tests.

Run the two AC1 rows against the original predicate in an isolated scratch copy as described in PLAN.md, recording expected failures. The starting snapshot already contains the partial fix; do not mislabel its results as pre-fix evidence. Then run on the completed candidate:

```bash
go test -timeout=5m ./internal/workflow -run '^TestIssueWorkReplanContinuation$' -count=1
go test -race -timeout=5m ./internal/workflow -run '^Test(HasTrustedImplementationCurrentBindings|PartialImplementationPASSOnlyConsumers|ExplicitTesterRetry|TestPhase.*|TestRetry.*|Tester.*|IssueWork.*|ContinuationHumanApprovalBeforeRepair)$' -count=1
go vet ./internal/workflow
gofmt -l internal/workflow/execute_validation.go internal/workflow/implementation_test.go internal/workflow/work_validation_test.go
```

Require empty format output. Predicate unit cases cover matching/successor claim, changed/missing input bindings, optional checkpoint/policy-tree bindings, origin and verdict. Focused commands are expected under five minutes each. If measurements show a selection exceeds five minutes, split by test group and record the revised duration/ownership before continuing.

## Tester-owned independent review and reuse

Independently map the source diff and tests to both criteria. Confirm authentic initial PASS, stale evidence retained for AC1, fresh approval, WorkUnit invalidation for AC2, resumed-only counts, role order, and updated artifact delivery. Verify the PASS-only fixture retains unprefixed keys and adds matching trusted copies with no assertion changes; all existing tester-retry/continuation tests must be unchanged. Check pre-fix failure is the requested scheduling bug, not setup or approval failure.

Inspect both role calculations and validation reuse. Confirm all current input bindings are compared with trusted prefixes except review_claim_id, while candidate/claim admission remains authoritative and unchanged. Reuse applicable passing developer results for the same source identity; run additional targeted checks only for missing evidence, relevant changes, observed failures or unresolved coverage concerns. Do not repeat the full selection solely for independent role separation.

## Evidence and applicability

Developer records commands, statuses, duration, logs and exact predicate variant in `.swarm/active/IMPLEMENTATION.md`; tester records independent findings and reused evidence in `.swarm/active/VALIDATION.md`. Logs may reside under `.swarm/active/`. Identify commit/tree plus uncommitted diff digest, or exact changed-file hashes when Git metadata is unavailable. Record scratch pre-fix and final candidate identities separately. Relevant source/fixture changes invalidate affected results; unrelated role artifact edits do not. No tests have been executed by this planner and no prior passing results are claimed.

## Coordinator-owned reference policy

The coordinator alone runs the complete trusted-base required policy once after roles finish, on the final candidate. It is not a developer/tester checklist. Agent results remain advisory and cannot satisfy claim-bound validation or publication.

Check expected above five minutes: complete trusted-base policy; owner **coordinator**; expected duration 5–15 minutes aggregate. Evidence: claim-bound coordinator validation attestation and command logs tied to the final candidate and approved policy identity. Later publication reuses that result only when identity remains applicable. Repeat only for relevant changes, failures or unresolved coverage concerns. No other check is planned above five minutes.
